title: Traditional and ChatGPT requirements-elicitation project
summary: Teams choose a real system, elicit and specify its requirements through standard techniques, then ask ChatGPT 3.5 to generate requirements for the same system. They compare both sets for equivalence, innovation, pertinence, and relevance and submit a technical report after 30 days.
